Goal/Input/Constraints
* Please fix the typo: lenght => length.

Input
* This section doesn't match the actual input format. It describes a single input line, but the input actually consists of three lines. Please update this section accordingly.

Output
* This section lists "Regular Brick" as one of the possible outputs, while the cases use "Regular brick" instead. Please make the capitalisation consistent.

Constraints
* Please change 100000 to 10000.

Stub generator
* Please use the same variable names as those used in the other sections.

Cases
* The name for Validator 1 is missing.

Thanks.

Below is the updated list of issues:

Input
* Please write one description for every line, in this format:

<<Line 1>>: An integer for the [[length]] of a brick.
<<Line 2>>: (etc.)

Constraints
* Please correct the typo: lenght => length.

Stub generator
* The variables are in different order from the Input section. Which one is correct? Please be consistent.

By the way, please either remove the other contribution or change its status to Private/WIP if you still want to work on it.

Thanks.
